```text
14.1 Playing Deep Pre-Flop

Deep Stacks = More Implied
Odds

This is the first important consideration
for playing deep pre-flop. Hero is very
often able to widen up his ranges for
both flatting opens and flatting 3-bets.
As always, when implied odds are high
he should favour flatting hands that have
a lot of nut potential (NP) such as
pocket pairs, suited connectors and
suited aces. We looked at this attribute
when we considered starting hands way
```

```text
by flatting in position. He will have the
option of making large flop raises, big
```

```text
stacks. It flops terribly the vast majority

bluff since it blocks none of Villain's 3-
bet value range whatsoever.
```
